description: Shared inputs that the React and Blazor lanes must both consume, with identical expected producer code+pointer lists. The Records editor consumption is not implemented in either lane.

recordsEditorConsumption.nativeRecordsAdapter: does not exist; nothing here asserts one

nativeExemplar.note: The existing Rules authoring editor is the lane-pattern reference only. Its types are not the Records contract.

react.refusalShape: { code, pointer, target? } rendered as given (tsx:21-22)

blazor.incomingWhenDirty: _incoming + 'Revision changed.' with explicit Keep edits / Discard edits (razor:46,76)
blazor.responseMatch: requestId outstanding and identity, expectedRevision and generation equal (razor:83)

cases.bothLanesExpect: Render each producer refusal list exactly as given, in order (code and pointer from records-refusal-cases.json), with no reordering, merging or client-originated codes.

inputSequence.source: RecordTypeDefinitionStoreTests.cs:182-197 (resave gives revision 2; a stale save at 1 refuses definition.revision_conflict /expectedRevision)

bothLanesExpect.clean: Replace the value, advance the generation and clear refusals (exemplar razor:76, tsx:76)
bothLanesExpect.dirty: Hold the incoming value pending an explicit Keep or Discard; never replace silently
bothLanesExpect.staleResponse: Ignore a response whose identity, expectedRevision or generation does not match

cases.status: expectationMetadata; no Records state machine is implemented

cases.constraintFloorLabel: required=true is the existing floor from the source tests
cases.bothLanesExpect: Treat a kind VERSION change as its own case, separate from an identity or revision change. No value or metadata clearing rule is applied (none is approved).
cases.status: producer outcome is test-grounded; lane behaviour is expectationMetadata

readOnly.bothLanesExpect: Controls disabled; no change or operation callback is emitted (exemplar razor:43,132).

producerOrdering.fact: CreateDraftAsync mints the name (RecordTypeDocument identity) before materializing or compiling kinds (RecordTypeDefinitionStore.cs:117 before 122). A request carrying both R1's name and R6's kind therefore refuses only records.identity.name_required at /name.
producerOrdering.status: sourceDerivedExpected from code reading; not asserted by any existing test

cases.uiOrderingNote: Any 'kind-before-name' or pending-revision UI ordering is expectation metadata only and must not reorder producer refusals.
